reviews.title: Scam
reviews.text:
Update: After posting this review, I finally got a response confirming cancellation, I still haven’t received a response regarding my refund request that I sent on the 28th and 30th of October. 

This app is a scam. I reached out on the 21st of this month to cancel and of course they make the cancellation process overly complicated. I created the account via my Apple ID but the app doesn’t show under my subscription tab. So I went back to the web browser and app to see if they had an option available to cancel and it doesn’t. I never received an email confirmation of the payment or how I subscribed but  I was charged last week and today. I reached out to customer service via the chat and email and still haven’t heard anything. Today I was charged a second time even though I requested cancellation last week. I wouldn’t recommend this app at all. Solvely you need to respond and cancel this subscription.

reviews.title: Slow, Not free, Terrible study material
reviews.text: Honestly the study material is mid, if you are starting from knowing nothing you will have a hard time if you are doing complex material. They simplify it too much and remove important key details about the material in the study guide. Every button is slow, like if you were to want them to simplify it or explain more it will take at least a minute for them to do that for you (and it isn’t even that good). The ai helper is stupid, and the call option is severely slow it’d probably be hours until you can get on. Overall, this app is severely undeveloped and isn’t useful yet. And before you even get to the practice exam they ask for you to pay a subscription.
